locations.note: The game begins and ends at the Warriors' home turf, where the Rogues wait and the Riffs arrive to punish them and call off the hit.
After Cyrus calls a gang conclave in the Bronx, Luther shoots him, the police raid the meeting and the Warriors are framed for the murder.
A fire stops the train, and the Warriors go on foot into the Orphans' territory.
Swan, Snow, Ajax and Cowboy defeat the Baseball Furies here, and Ajax is arrested by an undercover cop.
The Lizzies lure Rembrandt, Vermin and Cochise into a trap, and Swan and Mercy walk here to reunite with the others.

routes.name: The Warriors
routes.note: From Coney Island to the Bronx conclave and back across the city.
